clips.title: The story
paras: In Southshore, Marshal Marcus Redpath holds Lordaeron's last southern bastion on the coast. He organizes patrols and bounty contracts against nearby ogres, murlocs, and naga.

Marshal Marcus Redpath guards Southshore, the Alliance port on the southern coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. The town endured the fall of Lordaeron's capital and the devastating Scourge invasion. Redpath now leads its defense, protecting the survivors who remain there.

Southshore stands virtually alone against hostile forces pressing in from every side. Marshal Redpath coordinates the defense across the Hillsbrad Foothills and enlists seasoned adventurers to push back the Crushridge ogres advancing from Alterac. He also sends them against dangerous naga and murloc encampments along the coast. The Forsaken occupy the north, and nearby Tarren Mill is heavily fortified. Redpath's vigilance helps keep the Alliance presence in the region from collapsing.
